name: cli_reference_parity
logic_name: CLI reference parity and question review

test_list.description: Every local demo command opens its view without sending a backend request or starting a prompt.
Unknown commands retain the draft and report an error.
Ordinary scripted responses never steal composer focus.
Backspace/Delete act at the Unicode cursor and on selected text.
Question notes preserve the shared grapheme boundary contract.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Ordered keyboard, paste and mouse events.

output_description: Local navigation/edit transition without unintended backend execution.
